title: review follow-ups of PR #34489: lookupFilters { $record } to a structural field (json, repeater, location, address, vector) lints clean
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPJxG4vBVaLCBWLcWJ

Filing gate: L1/L2 follow-ups of a landed PR (one card per PR), from the contract review record 6932506491 on PR #34489 (card #34378, merged as f23c71e96e), out-of-diff observation ③.

## 维护者速读

- 现象：查找字段 `lookupFilters` 里的 `{ $record: "路径" }` 如果指向结构型字段(json、repeater、location、address、vector),同样没有单个可比较的值，但 #34489 只拒多值字段，这类路径今天 lint 仍放行。
- 影响：作者写了也不报错，客户端会拿一个对象去做单值比较，过滤看着对、实际不生效。这是读码推断，没有实测，也没找到现成的使用者。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Items

- [ ] `object-field-ref-unknown`, `lookupFilters[N].value.$record` member: a path whose head or leaf is a structural field type (json, repeater, location, address, vector; take the set from `packages/spec`, do not hand-write a second list) has no scalar value either. Decide with the spec lane whether the same rule refuses it, with the same hint as the multi-valued refusal, and pin it beside the multi-valued block in `packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.test.ts`. Measure first: `git grep` for a `$record:` path to such a field across `examples/`, `packages/platform-objects`, `packages/plugins` and `skills/` (PR #34489 measured zero `$record` paths first-party).

The client half for a plain multi-valued path is #34389; N1 of the same record (the "is not resolved" wording) is an accepted deviation carried there.

## Business reason

A metadata author who points `{ $record }` at an address or a JSON field gets a clean lint and a filter that never matches. Refusing it where it is written gives them the fix at authoring time, the same promise #34489 made for multi-valued fields.

## Reader who acts

The spec/lint area of seat `repo:objectstack#2` (area o2-A), which landed #34489.

## Dedupe

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue "34489"` → 1 hit (#34378, closed, the parent card); `is:issue lookupFilters $record json repeater` → 5 hits, none about this gap.
